title: UP's 2nd Largest Tunnel Gets Overhaul
summary: UP Track Renewal Train (TRT) Gang 909 replaced more than 10,000 feet of track in the tunnel and completed 59 boutet welds, while local section gangs installed 397 ties by hand.
